disposition: RESEARCH_PARTIAL. Official Windows descriptors and small installer bootstrapper evidence delivered. Complete browser-package acquisition and native acceptance remain OPEN.
changes: Added official acquisition identities for both browsers and both declared Windows architectures, with exact descriptor versions and URLs.
Retained original descriptor bytes, hashed local small bootstrappers and recorded REA managed/PE-resource evidence.
Separated signatures, extraction and runtime limitations; recorded all reference interaction states as NOT_RUN.
Added local-only exclusions for original bootstrapper and HTML acquisition inputs.
No production patch, message, command/ActionItem, codec/Model/classifier or native test change; no prepared-source base/result applies.
checks: Eight retained acquisition-input byte identities pass sha256sum --check.
Both bootstrapper managed identities match REA SHA-256, size, assembly version and MVID.
All four official MSIX URLs return HTTP 200 to HEAD only.
Canonical JSON, packet text whitespace and README relative-link checks pass; exact calls and limits in checks.json.

ownerQuestions.question: Which supported Windows test host and architecture will be used, and may the coordinator acquire its matching official full MSIX package and declared dependencies?
ownerQuestions.recommendation: Match the designated Windows test host first. Retain the other architecture as OPEN until scoped.
ownerQuestions.tradeoff: Both architectures expand static package coverage but require additional large downloads. This task prohibits those downloads.
ownerQuestions.route: Coordinator consolidates for root/owner; not asked directly.

ownerQuestions.question: Is an existing Arc account authorized and available for reference scenarios before the published sunset, or should Arc runtime remain unavailable?
ownerQuestions.recommendation: Keep Arc documentary/static-only if no authorized existing account is available.
ownerQuestions.tradeoff: The publisher no longer allows new accounts. Dia observations cannot establish Arc runtime behavior.
ownerQuestions.route: Coordinator consolidates for root/owner; no credentials requested.

integrationRequests.request: Preserve four exact package tuples and null MSIX hashes; arrange separately authorized full package/dependency acquisition and an allowed extraction evidence location.

Review authored evidence and original descriptors. .exe and .html originals remain local ignored inputs, not product payloads.
Do not infer same-window multi-Profile or same-live-page handoff completion from any acquisition/static result.
